weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Unfulfilled Yearning
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%** and increases their Max HP by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer is attacked or consumes their own HP, their DMG increases by **24/28/32/36/40%**. This effect is removed after the wearer uses an attack.

passive.name: Spare No Effort
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The wearer also deals an extra **20/25/30/35/40%** of DMG to enemies whose current HP percentage is equal to or higher than the wearer's current HP percentage.

substatLine: SPD (Breakpoint) > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: Lightning Rush
entries.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to **100%** of Arlan's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Shackle Breaker
entries.text: Consumes Arlan's HP equal to **15%** of his Max HP to deal Lightning DMG equal to **240%** of Arlan's ATK to one designated enemy. If Arlan does not have sufficient HP, his HP will be reduced to 1 after using his Skill.

entries.name: Frenzied Punishment
entries.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to **320%** of Arlan's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to **160%** of Arlan's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Pain and Anger
entries.text: Based on Arlan's current missing HP percentage, gains DMG bonus, up to a maximum increase of **72%** DMG dealt by Arlan.

entries.name: Swift Harvest
entries.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to **80%** of Arlan's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Revival
entries.text: If the current HP percentage is **30%** or lower when defeating an enemy, immediately restores HP equal to **20%** of Max HP.

entries.name: Endurance
entries.text: The chance to resist DoT Debuffs increases by **50%**.

entries.name: Repel
entries.text: Upon entering battle, if Arlan's HP percentage is less than or equal to **50%**, he can nullify all DMG received except for DoTs until he is attacked.

entries.name: To the Bitter End
entries.text: When HP percentage is lower than or equal to 50% of Max HP, increases DMG dealt by Skill by 10%.

entries.name: Breaking Free
entries.text: Using Skill or Ultimate removes 1 debuff from this unit.

entries.name: Power Through
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Turn the Tables
entries.text: When struck by a killing blow after entering battle, instead of becoming knocked down, Arlan immediately restores his HP to 25% of his Max HP. This effect is automatically removed after it is triggered once or after 2 turn(s) have elapsed.

entries.name: Hammer and Tongs
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Self-Sacrifice
entries.text: When the current HP percentage drops to 50% or below, Ultimate deals 20% more DMG, and the DMG multiplier for adjacent targets is raised to the same level as that for the primary target.

items.name: Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow
